slots.home.meta.title: Websites, Apps & AI Automation
slots.home.meta.description: Rapid Studios builds websites, iOS and Android apps, and practical AI automations for business owners. Start with a 15-minute project call with Travis.
slots.home.hero.description: Make it easier for customers to contact you, use your services, and come back. We build websites, iOS and Android apps, and AI automations around how your business works.
slots.home.audience.label: Built for your business
slots.home.differentiators.item1.title: Start with the problem
slots.home.differentiators.item1.description: Tell us where customers get stuck or your team loses time. We'll identify a practical first project.
slots.home.differentiators.item2.title: Know what you're buying
slots.home.differentiators.item2.description: Agree the deliverables, price, timeline, and access needed before the build starts.
slots.home.differentiators.item3.title: See progress as we build
slots.home.differentiators.item3.description: Review the work at agreed milestones, with room to catch issues before launch.
slots.home.differentiators.item4.title: Keep control after launch
slots.home.differentiators.item4.description: Keep your custom code, designs, and content. Third-party tools and assets retain their own licenses.
slots.home.services.title: What would help your business?
slots.home.services.description: Start with the customer experience or everyday task you want to improve. We'll help you choose the right build.
slots.home.services.item1.title: Websites
slots.home.services.item1.description: Help visitors understand your offer, see proof of your work, and get in touch through a clear, easy-to-use website.
slots.home.services.item2.title: iOS & Android apps
slots.home.services.item2.kicker: Make your service easy to use
slots.home.services.item2.description: Give customers a convenient way to book, manage their account, or use your service. We scope the app around the tools and access you have.
slots.home.services.item3.title: AI automations
slots.home.services.item3.description: Reduce repetitive intake, follow-up, and reporting work with practical workflows, clear review points, and the integrations your tools support.
slots.home.portfolio.title: See the work behind the offer
slots.home.portfolio.description: Explore the problem, solution, and technology behind each project.
slots.home.portfolio.item1.title: CodeVerified
slots.home.portfolio.item1.summary: AI-powered code review platform that analyzes repositories and generates actionable engineering reports.
slots.home.portfolio.item1.imageAlt: Created a scalable platform for automated technical due diligence on software projects.
slots.home.portfolio.item2.title: Sant Electric
slots.home.portfolio.item2.summary: Custom website for a Utah electrical contractor, with quote requests that land directly in the company's JobTread CRM and a guided quote assistant.
slots.home.portfolio.item2.imageAlt: Old and new Sant Electric homepages, compared side by side.
slots.home.portfolio.item3.title: AI Operations Automation for Physical Therapy
slots.home.portfolio.item3.summary: AI-powered system for streamlining recruiting, financial analysis, and operational decision-making in a growing physical therapy clinic.
slots.home.portfolio.item3.imageAlt: Designed a local-first automation system for recruiting, KPI analysis, and clinic planning.
slots.home.reasons.title: Where a useful project starts
slots.home.reasons.item1.title: Visitors aren't sure what to do next
slots.home.reasons.item1.description: Make your offer easier to understand, answer the questions that slow buyers down, and give visitors a clear way to contact you.
slots.home.reasons.item2.title: Customers need an easier way to use your service
slots.home.reasons.item2.description: Bring the important tasks into a focused app experience, from bookings and memberships to account access. Confirm integrations before committing to the build.
slots.home.reasons.item3.title: Your team keeps doing the same tasks
slots.home.reasons.item3.description: Look for repeatable work in lead intake, follow-up, and reporting. Start with one workflow your team can review and measure.
slots.home.process.title: Plan. Build. Improve.
slots.home.process.item1.title: Plan
slots.home.process.item1.description: Choose the problem to solve, agree scope and success measures, and confirm the tools and access needed.
slots.home.process.item2.title: Build
slots.home.process.item2.description: Review the design and working build at agreed milestones so you can see how it will work for your customers and team.
slots.home.process.item3.title: Improve
slots.home.process.item3.description: Test the core flows, launch the agreed scope, and use feedback to choose the next improvement or support plan.
slots.home.nextSteps.title: From first conversation to a clear plan
slots.home.nextSteps.description: You don't need a finished brief. Bring the idea or the problem you're trying to solve.
slots.home.nextSteps.item1.title: 15-minute project call
slots.home.nextSteps.item1.description: Talk with Travis about your business, what's getting in the way, and the outcome you want. No prep or commitment needed.
slots.home.nextSteps.item2.title: A scope you can review
slots.home.nextSteps.item2.description: If we're a fit, review the deliverables, price, timing, and any integration or ongoing costs before deciding.
slots.home.nextSteps.item3.title: Build with clear milestones
slots.home.nextSteps.item3.description: Once scope and access are agreed, work begins with a clear review process and launch plan.
slots.home.cta.title: What would you like to make easier?
slots.home.cta.description: Bring an idea, an existing website, or one task that takes too much time. Start with a 15-minute call with Travis.
